description: Update fields in a single record matched by a where clause. If no sort-key changes, updates in place; otherwise marks old record ignored and appends to merge file.

set.description: JSON object of fields to update, e.g. {"status": "done"}

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

where.description: JSON object of filter conditions for which records to update, e.g. {"id": "123"}

name: chaprola_update_record
